capNote: The solo-dev guard, operator-owned. Projected monthly spend of in-use services may never exceed this — enforced by tools/check-services.mjs in CI, the same way unsourced strategies fail CI. Raise it deliberately, in a commit, when revenue justifies it.

assumptions.note: Planning cadence for unit economics. A hypothesis until real production data exists.

services.name: Remotion
services.license: Remotion license — free for individuals and ≤3-person teams
services.futureLiability: Automated rendering at company scale is Remotion's 'Automators' tier: $0.01/render with a $100/mo minimum (Master Doc §3). Trigger: incorporating, >3 people, or render farm.

decision.rationale: Programmatic React video — every visual element is an A/B-able parameter, which the optimization loop requires. ~20x ecosystem of alternatives.
Most natural free local voice; replaced Piper after the v0.8.0 'sounds like TTS' feedback.

services.name: Directed open-weights voice (Orpheus/Chatterbox-class)
services.license: Apache-2.0 (Orpheus) / MIT (Chatterbox) — commercially safe; note XTTS (CPML) and F5-TTS checkpoints (CC-BY-NC) FAIL our license gate for a monetized channel
services.adoptionTrigger: Build the voice-direction layer (per-beat emphasis/pacing/energy — authored, free) + evaluate against Kokoro in operator scores on the performance-voice dimension.

decision.rationale: Free-first doctrine: the next voice tier up requires no payment, only integration + direction.

services.name: ElevenLabs (directed human-grade TTS)
services.license: Commercial API terms; synthetic-voice disclosure already enforced at Gate publish

pricing.note: Starter tier ~$5/mo covers ~8 videos/mo of narration; est ≤$0.30/video marginal

services.adoptionTrigger: AFTER the open-voice upgrade + direction layer: performance-voice dimension still scores <6/10 in operator calibration scores across ≥2 videos, i.e. voice remains a measured limiting dimension (calibration ledger evidence required).

decision.rationale: Buys the last ~20-30% of narration performance for cents/video. A performance is the one layer that cannot be authored, only directed. Adoption is evidence-gated, not taste-gated.

services.name: Cue-structured procedural music (ours)
services.adoptionTrigger: Extend synth-audio from drone+SFX to cue-based composition (motif/build/hit/resolve) aligned to the beat timeline — a structural advantage no licensed library offers.

decision.rationale: Music is the lowest-weighted rubric dimension; structural alignment to reveals matters more than production gloss at this stage.

services.name: genAI video clips (Veo/Kling-class API)
services.license: Per-provider commercial terms; provenance {model,prompt,seed} + disclosure already enforced (v0.9.0)

pricing.note: ~$0.10-0.50/clip × 10-20 clips IF a video uses generated world-footage throughout

services.adoptionTrigger: Only if the channel direction adds a cinematic live-action layer (Fern/Harris-style). The chosen direction — authored animation (Kurzgesagt/3B1B-class) — does NOT require it; open-weights video (Wan/LTX on gpu-rental) evaluates first if the trigger ever fires.

decision.rationale: Parked: wrong substrate for the chosen direction. Recorded so the option and its price stay visible.
alternatives: Wan/LTX open weights on rented GPU

services.name: GPU rental (compute for open-weights models)

pricing.note: ~$0.30-0.60/hr, est ≤2 GPU-hours/video if open voice/music/video models are adopted

services.adoptionTrigger: Adopting any open-weights model whose CPU inference is too slow for the production cadence. This is paying for COMPUTE, not capability — the models stay ours.

decision.rationale: The bridge that keeps the free-first doctrine viable at production speed.

services.name: Openverse + Library of Congress
services.license: PD/CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-SA via the tested license gate (NC/ND rejected — monetized channel)

decision.rationale: Rights-clean archival imagery with auditable provenance.

services.name: YouTube (distribution + revenue platform)
services.license: Platform ToS; synthetic-media disclosure enforced at Gate publish

pricing.model: free; platform takes 45% of ad revenue (RPM figures are net already)

services.revenueRole: Primary. RPM is niche-dependent — education long-form commonly $3-12 net; treated as a HYPOTHESIS range until our own analytics exist.

decision.rationale: The channel's home; Data/Analytics APIs feed the learning loop.
